newsitem.title: FRANCE: French UIC suspended limit down.
newsitem.headline: French UIC suspended limit down.

text.p: Shares in UIC, a property financing firm controlled by insurer GAN, were suspended limit down for the rest of the day and an attempt to requote at lower levels will be made on Thursday, a spokesman for the SBF stock markets' association said.
The fall came after UIC's chairman said the share was considerably overvalued on the basis of its negative net asset value.

UIC is expected to post losses for the year in excess of one billion francs. GAN, which is to recapitalise UIC to the tune of 800 million francs, said it would have no difficulty meeting its obligations to UIC.
UIC was supended at 0935 GMT at 45 francs, down 10.30 francs or 18.6 percent.
GAN added 1.7 percent to 115 francs in a slightly lower market.
